title: Exact condensed coefficient changes and their derived tensor calculus
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$ [def-weil-l-adic-numbers], an algebraic closure $\Omega=\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$ [def-weil-algebraic-closure], and a scheme $T$ [def-pc-scheme] whose underlying space is noetherian (every ascending chain of open subsets stabilizes). For finite intermediate fields $E\subseteq\Omega$ [def-weil-finite-subextension-directed-set], put $E_T^c=p_T^*C(-,E)$ using [def-weil-pbc-condensed-e-module-category]. Put $\Omega_T^c=p_T^*\underline\Omega$, where $\underline\Omega(S)$ consists of continuous functions on a profinite set $S$ with image in one finite intermediate field. A module sheaf is constructible if it has a finite locally closed stratification on each stratum of which it is pro-etale locally the cokernel of a map between finite rank free modules over the restricted coefficient ring. For every finite $E\subseteq F\subseteq\Omega$, the underlying $E_T^c$-module of $F_T^c$ is finite free of rank $[F:E]$. For $B=F_T^c$ or $B=\Omega_T^c$, extension of scalars $B\otimes_{E_T^c}-$ on all module sheaves is exact and left adjoint to exact restriction of scalars $U_{B/E}$. Its derived functor is computed by termwise tensor on any representing complex, preserves distinguished triangles and shifts, and has the natural adjunction $$\operatorname{Hom}_{D(B)}(B\otimes_{E_T^c}^L K,L)\cong\operatorname{Hom}_{D(E_T^c)}(K,U_{B/E}L).$$ For finite $E\subseteq F\subseteq G$ and also $G=\Omega$, tensor multiplication gives natural comparisons $$G_T^c\otimes_{F_T^c}^L(F_T^c\otimes_{E_T^c}^L K)\cong G_T^c\otimes_{E_T^c}^L K.$$ Together with the unit comparison for $E=F$, these satisfy the unit and pentagon identities and the analogous identities for shifts. Under restriction to $E_T^c$-modules, tensor commutes with the coefficient colimit: if $\Omega_T^c\cong\varinjlim_{F\supseteq E}F_T^c$, then $\varinjlim_{F\supseteq E}(F_T^c\otimes_{E_T^c}P)\cong\Omega_T^c\otimes_{E_T^c}P$ naturally for every module sheaf $P$.
